# EkeBoss Restaurant — Client Brief

## Description

EkeBoss Restaurant is a mid-sized Nigerian cuisine restaurant based in Lagos, Nigeria. They serve authentic jollof rice, suya, egusi soup, and other traditional Nigerian dishes. The business has a strong walk-in trade but is looking to grow their online presence and enable online table reservations.

## Business objectives

- Increase online visibility and organic search traffic
- Enable online table bookings
- Showcase the menu online with photos and pricing
- Build a loyal customer base with email marketing
- Expand to a second location within 18 months

## Target customers

Professionals aged 25–45 in Lagos who enjoy Nigerian cuisine and are comfortable booking online. Also targeting the diaspora visiting Lagos.

## Known URLs

https://ekeboss.example.com

## Services

- Dine-in restaurant experience
- Private event hosting
- Catering services
- Takeaway orders

## Desired outcomes

- Online table reservation system working on mobile
- Improved mobile user experience
- Faster page load times
- Better SEO ranking for "Nigerian restaurant Lagos"
- Integration with Google My Business

## Constraints

- Limited budget — prefer minimal-dependency solutions
- Existing WordPress site must be preserved
- Current hosting is shared cPanel hosting
- SSL certificate is already installed

## Known platform

wordpress

## Known integrations

- Google Analytics
- WhatsApp Business (for orders)

## Open questions

- Do they have access to their WordPress admin credentials?
- Is the current theme a premium theme or custom?
- What booking plugin (if any) is currently installed?
- Is there a staging environment available?
- Who currently manages the website?
